{{Short description|Football tournament stage}}
The '''2023 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 4 April to 29 June 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://d2soj90bepqxla.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Calendario-2023_aprobado-Consejo-07-julio-2022.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2023: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=7 July 2022|access-date=7 July 2022}}</ref><ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Fixture-Libertadores_Fase-de-Grupos-CL-2023_para-publicacion.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2023 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 28/03/2023|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=28 March 2023|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2023 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2023-1.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Libertadores / Manual de Clubes 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|access-date=7 February 2023}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 27 March 2023, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sistema-de-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana/|title=Sistema de sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana|trans-title=CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana draw system|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=20 March 2023|access-date=22 March 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-grupos-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-2023/|title=Develado el camino a la Gloria Eterna 2023|trans-title=The path to the Eternal Glory 2023 is unveiled|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 March 2023|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref><noinclude>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 9 December 2022 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2023|title=Ranking de Clubes CONMEBOL 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|date=16 December 2022|access-date=17 December 2022|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2013–2022.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2012 and 2002–2012 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The defending champions [[CR Flamengo|Flamengo]] were directly assigned as the top seed of Group A (position A1). The remaining teams were distributed into four pots according to their CONMEBOL Clubs ranking. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2023 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]].<section end=Format />
